-क्मम् 
__1 Gold; निक्षेपस्यापहरणं … … रुक्मस्तेयसमं स्मृतम् [[

.]] 
__2 Iron. 
-Comp. 
-अङ्गद a. wearing golden armlets. 
-आभ a. shining like gold, bright; [[

.]] 
-कारकः a goldsmith. 
-पात्री a golden dish; भुञ्जते रुक्मपात्रीषु युधिष्ठिरनिवेशने [[

-रथः, -वाहनः N. of Droṇa.

a. 
__1 Wearing golden ornaments. 
__2 Gilded. -m. N. of the eldest son of Bhīṣmaka and brother of Rukmiṇī.

The daughter of Bhīṣmaka of Vidarbha. [She was betrothed by her father to Śiśupāla, but she secretly loved Kṛṣṇa and sent him a letter praying him to take her away. Kṛṣṇa with Balarāma came and snatched her off after having defeated her [Page1343-2] brother in battle. She bore to Kṛṣṇa a son named Pradyumna.].

a. 
__1 Ved. Shining, brilliant. 
__2 = रूक्ष q. v.

a. (written as रुक्ष also) 
__1 Rough, harsh, not smooth or soft (as touch, sound &c.); पुंस्कोकिलगिरं श्रुत्वा रूक्षा ध्वाङ्क्षस्य वागिव [[

.]] 
__2 Astringent (taste). 
__3 Rough, uneven, difficult, austere. 
__4 Sullied, soiled, dirtied; रथतुरगरजोभिस्तस्य रूक्षालकाग्रा [[

.]] 
__6 Arid, parched up, dry, dreary; स्निग्धश्यामाः क्वचिदपरतो भीषणाभोगरूक्षाः [[

.]] (रूक्षीकृ means ‘to make rough’, ‘soil’, ‘besmear’). 
-क्षः 
__1 A tree. 
__2 Harshness, hardness. 
-क्षा 
__1 Croton Polyandrum (Mar. दन्ती). 
__2 Honey sugar. 
-क्षम् 
__1 The thick part of curds. 
__2 A good kind of iron. 
__3 Black pepper. 
-Comp. 
-गन्धः, -गन्धकः bdellium. 
-पत्रः the Śākhoṭa tree. 
-पेषम् ind. [Page1346-2] without the addition of any liquid; as in रूक्षपेषं पिनष्टि; [[

.]] 
-भावः unfriendly behaviour. 
-वर्ण a. dark-coloured (as clouds). 
-वालुकम् honey of a small bee. 
-स्वरः an ass.

__1 To be rough or harsh.

a. 
__1 Made rough. 
__2 Soiled, covered with dirt.
